messages:
maria: FYI — scheduling a blue/green flip for /v1/generate at 03:00 UTC during the change window. Plan: incremental traffic shifts 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 5m holds. Posting preflight checklist now.
ken: Preflight: verify config drift, certs, model pin fallback, and canary evals. I validated canary evals on green (staging->prod parity good).
allegra: I will watch infra/host metrics, enable manual hold between steps. Ken, can you pin fallback version in router before we start?
sam: I'll draft a short release note and tag the deploy commit; will post link here.
devops-oncall: Oncall ack. Rule: if error-rate > 1% sustained during a hold or user-visible tail latency > +20% -> rollback immediate and page #incidents.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued route shift for /v1/generate -> green v2026.03, initial target 10% @ 03:00:00 UTC (manual holds enabled).
router-service: router-service: health checks passing on green nodes. p95 latency = 82ms (baseline blue p95 = 79ms). KV cache warm ~70%.
maria: OK go at 03:00. Remember to keep canary logs and sampling on for traces.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting shift -> green 10%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shift to 10% complete. metrics snapshot: errors=0.2%, p95+3ms, qps stable.
maria: looks clean. Proceed to 30% on my mark.
ken: marking next step ready.
maria: proceed.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shifting to 30%...
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: shift to 30% complete. Observability: error-rate jumped to 1.4% (spike in 5xx). Traces show contention in tokenization on green workers. Pausing rollout and notifying team.
allegra: Pausing confirmed. I'm watching hosts; thread locks visible on green worker set.
ken: Initiating rollback to blue per policy. Triggering drain of green and re-pin to previous version.
router-service: router-service: executing rollback steps. Command run: ```
routerctl set-weight /v1/generate green=0 blue=100 --grace 90
routerctl pin /v1/generate v2026.02 --sticky 24h
```
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback in progress, draining connections from green. Expected completion ~90s.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete. Traffic now 100% -> blue.
router-service: router-service: post-rollback metrics: p95=79ms, errors back to 0.1%. Logs collected and uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/rollbacks/1791234567/.
maria: Root cause: kernel update landed in green image that regressed tokenization lock under certain batch shapes. v2026.03 is blocked for promote until fix.
sam: Release notes updated: v2026.03 "blocked - performance regression"; commit tagged and team notified. Added rollback timeline and mitigation steps to the PR. Link: https://git.redwood.dev/r/release/456
ken: I'll open a follow-up PR to revert the kernel change on the green image and run a targeted stress test in staging.
allegra: Scheduling re-test in staging and will run the same canary eval suite. Thanks all for fast ops. :thumbsup:
maria: Closing this shift thread. We'll run another attempt after the kernel fix and a passing staging run.
